title: Pseudo-differential operator associated with the linear canonical Dunkl transform
summary: In this paper, we introduce a pseudo-differential operator associated with the linear canonical Dunkl transform. For a particular class of symbols, we prove that this operator defines a continuous linear mapping from the Schwartz space into itself. We further establish an amplitude integral and kernel representation of the operator and investigate the smoothness and decay properties of the associated kernel.
